title: A comment still says that the first entry wins

pr.title: Keep the newest contact for each email
pr.description: dedupe() now keeps the last entry for each email. The import lists contacts from oldest to newest, so the newest entry wins.

bugs.note: The unchanged comment says that the first entry for each email stays. The change makes the last entry win, so the comment is now false. Update the comment.

traps.why: The comment says that emails compare in lower case. keyOf still does that, so the comment is true. A stale-comment point on it is wrong.
